title: Division returns a decimal without any special-casing
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun eval(v) = v match {
  case n is Number -> n
  case o is Object -> evalNode(o)
}
fun evalNode(o) = o.op match {
  case "+" -> eval(o.l) + eval(o.r)
  case "-" -> eval(o.l) - eval(o.r)
  case "*" -> eval(o.l) * eval(o.r)
  case "/" -> eval(o.l) / eval(o.r)
}
---
eval(payload)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun eval(v) = v match {
  case n is Number -> n
  case o is Object -> evalNode(o)
}
fun evalNode(o) = o.op match {
  case "+" -> eval(o.l) + eval(o.r)
  case "-" -> eval(o.l) - eval(o.r)
  case "*" -> eval(o.l) * eval(o.r)
  case "/" -> eval(o.l) / eval(o.r)
}
---
eval(payload)

explanation.approach: `/` is never integer division in DataWeave, so this needs no extra handling to come out as `3.5`.
